method: Independent direct HTTP streamed originals, all source hashes/sizes/mtimes, and explicit source capture/container/auxiliary/pair/type expectations; no checker imports
inventory_comparison_baseline: Current date-coverage run raw before observation
container_date_semantics: Literal encoded movie/track/media creation fields agree with API fileCreatedAt; no photographic shutter-instant or originating-camera-timezone claim.
edited_date_semantics: The edited JPEG has no associated Takeout sidecar or cryptographically established parent with trusted capture evidence. Its declared XMP offset is not used to fabricate a capture instant.
fault_test_stage: Pairing and controlled source/destination/timeout receipts were executed before the final denominator and finite-number review patch and retained verbatim. Final frozen backend, wheel/browser, and final raw observations are separate evidence stages.
scope: Final raw observation follows all final backend, installed preview and clean browser lifecycle checks. Direct inventory re-enumeration brackets the original reads; no atomic snapshot claim.
privacy: No credentials, coordinates, account URLs, raw media or raw EXIF/XMP packets included.
